$comment: First runtime adapter of Enistere Foundation (E2, ADR-096), written from scratch on Adapter Protocol v0; realizes the shared API contracts its component provides since E5 (ADR-099).

verification.statement: The component directory matches its latest MaterializationRecord: every compiler-owned file is present and unchanged.
The project installs its pinned dependencies with npm.
The project compiles with TypeScript without error.
The service starts and answers GET /health with HTTP 200.
The service serves its shared API contracts as committed, rejects inputs that do not match them (400, Problem Details) and answers 501 for operations its team has not implemented yet.
The installed dependencies have no high or critical vulnerability.
